evidence: All 117 archive members inspected by file inventory; JavaScript, declarations, source maps and a coverage report; no install-time executable hook.

Entry point imports initializer, registers layout/snackbar Redux reducers and document event listeners. Overlay history responds to user navigation and Escape; URL tabs update the current URL; canvas controls copy a share link to the clipboard.
Coverage includes Google Code Prettify. Its minification and character conversion implement syntax highlighting, rather than a concealed payload.

forager recovered the npm tarball with identical SHA-256. Direct production dependencies at declared minimum versions were fetched and reviewed: Material web, Lit, Operato i18n, popup, shell, styles and utils. Their network/script/cookie helpers implement translation, caller-selected script loading, JWT parsing and browser cookies.
72333e53b47d.label_explanation: Source attribution for this item is unavailable. A likely false-positive source is generic UI keyboard/mouse listeners, clipboard handling and bundled/minified coverage JavaScript; that explanation is an inference, not a known origin.

evidence: 1304-member npm archive contains Solidity contracts, ABI/compiler artifacts, deployments and compiled deployment/test scripts. No install hook is present. Original tarball matches the authoritative npm bytes exactly.

Hardhat config uses explicitly supplied DEPLOYER_KEY and OWNER_KEY for transaction signing and INFURA_API_KEY for provider URLs; no arbitrary credential upload was found. The local deployment test starts an Anvil localhost server and invokes bun hardhat deploy.
DNS deployment code reads the public suffix list; wikiCheck compares documented deployment addresses against published contract deployment data. These referenced public resources were fetched.

CCIPReader.ccipRead(address,bytes) dispatches to a four-argument overload. That overload performs bounded static calls and returns/reverts through EIP-3668 OffchainLookup handling. The two-argument wrapper does not call itself.

The legitimate Solidity compiler pragma now prevents the JavaScript fallback from treating overload dispatch as runaway recursion. The header must precede code; a pragma quoted inside JavaScript cannot suppress real recursion.

Direct production dependencies solsha1 0.0.3, OpenZeppelin contracts 4.1.0 and dns-packet 5.3.0 were fetched and reviewed. buffer 0.1.1 could not be recovered after forager mirror/archive attempts; buffer 0.1.3, allowed by ^0.1.1, was recovered and inspected as an explicitly different version.
6958f9036192.label_explanation: The observed suspicious finding is an overloaded Solidity function misparsed as JavaScript recursion. Crypto addresses, ABI bytecode and token approvals are expected in a contract development distribution; they do not establish a wallet-stealing operation.

evidence: forager fetch --all-wheels pkg:pypi/ultralytics@8.1.2 recovered one wheel, byte-identical to the supplied SHA-256. All 188 RECORD entries were checked with no hash/size mismatch. Every ultralytics package file matches the upstream v8.1.2 source tag.

Import initializes settings and optional Sentry integration. YOLO entry points perform training, validation, inference and export; user-selected camera/screen input supports prediction. No concealed startup payload was found.

Settings hash uuid.getnode with SHA-256 and store settings/API keys. Optional sync sends documented model/task/runtime events to Google Analytics, and optional Sentry reports filtered library errors. HUB login uses a user API key or credentialed browser request in Colab; the browser-cookie prose is not a credential database path.

Dataset YAML download handlers can execute Python or bash when data is missing. Model activation configuration uses eval, torch.load deserializes checkpoints, and requirements checking may pip-install missing packages. These are real code execution surfaces and their notable detections remain.

NCNN export fetches a public PNNX release, extracts and moves the converter, chmods it to 0777, runs it on a TorchScript model and removes conversion intermediates. Edge TPU export installs a Google APT key/repository/compiler. These explicit tool-setup paths are not hidden persistence or evasion.

The exact fallback PNNX release archive and Google APT key were fetched. The referenced TensorFlow.js demo source was fetched and traced: image drop -> local model inference -> canvas labels. The four listed GitHub asset bundles were fetched and reviewed as GitHub code-view/React/Turbo UI; none is a wheel runtime dependency.
All dataset download programs were reviewed as image/label acquisition and conversion. Large external training datasets were not downloaded wholesale.
The model-visualization os.system example in nn/modules/__init__.py is a docstring, not an import-time command; its matchable source is retained as source syntax.

Rizin inspection of the fetched PNNX binary identifies a 64-bit x86 Linux C++ converter with an ordinary main(argc,argv) entry. The binary is stripped and Rizin skipped oversized string regions; the full converter was not executed or exhaustively decompiled. The wheel itself only invokes it within the explicit NCNN export path.
6c2be862f494.label_explanation: The fetched ThreatsDay article refers to the 2024 Ultralytics cache-poisoning incident in a paragraph about GitHub Actions cache controls. It does not identify this 8.1.2 wheel or its hash. Expanding a news mention into package/dependency URLs plausibly caused the hostile queue attribution; GitHub page UI assets also became incidental follow-on leads.
